prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Persistence Banner: Add a clear account persistence notice explaining that signing in ensures pets and custom progress are cloud-saved across app restarts.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in to securely cloud-save your pet and progress across app restarts and updates."}}
1: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Pet Generation Status Indicator: Display real-time visual step indicators showing progress (analyzing photo, rendering model) while custom pet is generating.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Creating your pet model..."}}
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Control Overview Walkthrough: Redesign home_intro into a spotlight layout explaining system tray access, pet interaction shortcuts, and pet visibility controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop!", "body": "Your pet is now active. Click the system tray icon anytime to customize or hide your pet."}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Naming Certificate Screen: Add a dedicated pet naming and adoption signing screen before final certificate generation with interactive pet naming input.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_naming", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_naming": {"headline": "Name Your Pet", "body": "Give your new companion a name to finalize the adoption papers.", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "label": "Pet Name"}]}}
4: [sign_in, reorder] Delayed Sign In Reordering Flow: Move the sign_in step after pet selection and photo upload, right before adoption certificate confirmation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
5: [home, redesign] Background Pet Preparation Waiting Screen: Redesign the waiting screen with a split layout featuring interactive tip carousels and estimated completion time while pet assets load.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tips while waiting"}]}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Benefit Cards: Update choose_path layout to two_column spotlight view clearly contrasting Quick Adopt (preset pet) vs Custom Creator (photo pet) paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Path", "body": "Select standard preset adoption or create a custom pet from photos."}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Pre-load Mascot Welcome Story: Add an encouraging welcome headline and progress tracker component on the story screen to set clear expectations for the onboarding process.
   config: {"story": {"show_step_counter": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Your companion is just a few quick steps away."}}
8: [finish, hint] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Notice: Add a clear diagnostic hint on home_intro explaining how to restore or bring the pet to front if display issues or multi-monitor overlaps occur.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Pet missing? Right-click the tray icon and select 'Bring Pet to Top'."}}
9: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Companion Habit Setup Flow: Add a habit selection sub-flow during adoption where users choose their pet's primary behavior mode on the desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_habit_setup", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_habit_setup": {"headline": "Pet Behavior & Habits", "body": "Choose how your pet acts on your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Behavior Mode"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding an account persistence hint on the sign-in screen is allowed within onboarding.
Adding real-time progress indicators to the photo upload screen is permitted.
Redesigning the home_intro screen layout within onboarding is permitted.
Adding a pet naming step inside onboarding retains all required steps and is allowed.
Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen while keeping its core job intact is allowed.
Redesigning choose_path while offering both preset and custom paths preserves the screen's job.
Adding step counter and progress information to the story screen is permitted.
Adding a diagnostic hint to home_intro is allowed as part of onboarding changes.
Adding a new habit setup sub-flow within onboarding is permitted by Rule 4.
